summary: Of 19 L3 candidates, 5 are confirmed (C-03, D-04, F-01, F-02, G-10), 14 corrected, 0 refuted and 0 unverified. The most important corrections are that C-01's proposed fallback already exists (the company simulation already falls back to the room package and room floor, which still produced nothing for real jobs) and that D-01 needs no code change: Vast and the other live providers are verified at zero, and deleting the RunPod key already makes the guard treat RunPod as retired. C-02 drops to P1 (November deploys counted at 153, not D-06's 129, and the rate has fallen); C-05, C-06, D-05, G-05, G-07 and IP-07 drop to P2, mostly because they hit only test jobs, err on the safe side, or are dead code or noise. G-07's merge proposal would remove load-bearing rate, fleet and Google Cloud money stops, and F-10 wrongly lists the money hard stop spend_unproven as a defect.
